formula: p_current[i,UF]=(1-alpha_uf)*p_census2022[i,UF]+alpha_uf*p_newborn2025[i,UF]; alpha_uf=registrations_uf/population_uf; conditioned p[i] ∝ p_cohort[i,UF]*national_IBGE_p_F[i], null-sex omitted, renormalized
limitations: The IBGE after2010 tail is national 2011-2020 evidence, not UF-observed post2010 data.
Arpen top50 is incomplete; residual mass is modeled, not observed by name.
No compound string or middle-name incidence is introduced.
population_denominator: IBGE official POP2026 UF population, including the explicit MT source-only municipality
provenance: Deterministic normalized float64 derivation; no UF post-2010 history is inferred.
sex_prior_scope: national IBGE 2022 empirical counts; not UF empirical observations
simple_only_decision: Only Arpen SIMPLE atomic first-name rows are observed newborn inputs; ALL and COMPOUND remain separate artifacts.
